Maximum Flexibility

Zero lock-in. Flutcom includes a global reactive store out of the box. Share state across your entire app seamlessly.

store.js
/**
 * Flutcom Reactive Store
 * Publish & Subscribe seamlessly
 */

const store = window.flutcomApp.store;

// Read from global state
let count = store.get('counter') || 0;

// Subscribe to UI updates
store.subscribe((key, val) => {
  if (key === 'counter') {
    ui.textContent = val;
  }
});

// Trigger reactivity
store.set('counter', count + 1);
